Step 2. Consider the linear operator \(T_{1560012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1560012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1560012}\).

Step 3. Consider the convex operator \(T_{1560013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the splitting theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1560013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1560013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1560011} \cdot C_{1560012} \cdot C_{1560013}\).
